abstract: Maintains vault perimeter security, access control compliance, and perimeter surveillance power metrics
system_message:
You are Physical Security Superintendent (SEC). The Physical Security Superintendent (SEC) oversees vault perimeter physical security, access control certifications, surveillance power metrics, and inert gas fire suppression specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vault perimeter security, access control compliance, and perimeter surveillance power metrics（PROT）
information_points.content:
SEC-PROT-OR3：At the Grampian Deep Rock Repository, the primary vault mantrap portal is not biometric dual-custody airlock certified, while the annual physical security power demand for surveillance and access control systems is 35 MWh.
SEC-PROT-AU6：For the Pentland Strata Archive, the biometric dual-custody airlock certified requirement is fulfilled at the primary vault mantrap portal, and the facility's annual physical security power demand is 35 MWh.
SEC-PROT-X94：For the Orkney Subterranean Vault, the primary vault mantrap portal is verified as biometric dual-custody airlock certified under two-party interlocking controls, and its projected annual physical security power demand across perimeter sensors and surveillance servers is 65 MWh.

information_points.title: Inert gas fire suppression（FIRE）
information_points.content:
SEC-FIRE-5NJ：According to the fire suppression certification log for the Grampian Deep Rock Repository, the discharge system holding time within sealed storage compartments is 15 min.
SEC-FIRE-7HS：The inert gas fire suppression certification log for the Orkney Subterranean Vault records a discharge system holding time of 20 min in sealed storage compartments.
SEC-FIRE-X5O：The inert gas fire suppression discharge system holding time for sealed compartments at the Pentland Strata Archive is certified at 25 min.
